jobs.title: Product Management Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Product Analytics & Business Intelligence

- Serve as the single-point analytical resource for all AC Power product lines, providing data-driven insights to Product Line Managers.

- Develop and maintain product performance dashboards tracking revenue, margin, order intake, backlog, and market share across all product lines.

- Conduct product profitability analysis including gross margin, contribution margin, and NMC trends for each product line.

- Perform product mix analysis and identify opportunities for margin improvement and portfolio optimization.

- Prepare Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with consolidated analytics across all AC Power product lines.

- Track and report on key product KPIs including win/loss rates, quote-to-order conversion, lead times, and customer satisfaction metrics.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

- Conduct competitive benchmarking across all product lines – analyzing competitor product features, pricing, positioning, and market share.

- Monitor market trends, technology shifts, and regulatory changes impacting AC Power products (e.g., data center growth, energy transition, grid modernization).

- Prepare market sizing and segmentation analysis for each product line to support strategic planning and investment decisions.

- Track industry developments in UPS, energy storage, switchgear, busway, microgrid, and power management software domains.

-
Support Product Line Managers with Voice of Customer (VoC) analysis and customer requirement mapping.

Product Line Support & Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Product Line Managers

- Support New Product Development & Introduction (NPDI) projects with market feasibility studies, business case preparation, and financial modeling.

- Coordinate with Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance teams to gather data and validate assumptions for product decisions.

-
Support SFA  and Localization projects with cost-benefit analysis and impact assessment.

Strategic Planning & Portfolio Management

- Support the Budget / Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process with product-level forecasts, market assumptions, and growth projections.

- Assist in product lifecycle management  decisions – including product launches, phase-outs, and end-of-life planning.

- Develop product roadmap analytics to help Product Line Managers prioritize investments and feature development.

- Prepare investment justification documents (business cases, ROI analysis) for new product initiatives and capacity expansion.

- Conduct portfolio health assessments using frameworks such as BCG Matrix, product lifecycle stage analysis, and margin-volume mapping.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

- Create and maintain standardized reporting templates  for consistent product performance tracking across all product lines.

- Prepare executive-level presentations and summaries for leadership reviews, strategy meetings, and board updates.

- Develop ad-hoc analytical reports as requested by Product Line Managers and senior leadership.

- Maintain a centralized product data repository ensuring data accuracy and accessibility for all stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience:

Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Business Administration.

- MBA (Marketing / Strategy / Operations) – strongly preferred.

Experience

- 10+ years of progressive experience in product analysis, product management, or business analysis within the power electronics / electrical equipment / industrial products industry.

- Minimum 3–5 years of experience supporting multiple product lines simultaneously.

- Demonstrated experience in market research, competitive intelligence, and product portfolio analytics .

- Proven track record of working with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance.

- Experience in data center infrastructure, power management, or energy solutions is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, advanced formulas, macros) and PowerPoint (executive-level presentations).

- Strong working knowledge of BI/Analytics tools – Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.

- Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP / Oracle) for extracting product, cost, and order data.

- Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce or equivalent) for pipeline and win/loss analysis.

- Knowledge of market research tools and databases (e.g., Frost & Sullivan, Mordor Intelligence, IHS Markit).

Domain Knowledge

- Strong understanding of AC Power products – UPS systems, Energy storage, Switchgear, Busway, Microgrids, PSD, and power management software.

- Familiarity with data center infrastructure , critical power, and cooling ecosystems.

- Understanding of industry standards and certifications relevant to power products (IEC, UL, IS standards).

- Knowledge of commodity markets and their impact on product costing (copper, steel, aluminum, semiconductors).

Behavioral Competencies

- Analytical Excellence – Ability to synthesize large volumes of data into clear, actionable insights.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works effectively across multiple product lines and functional teams simultaneously.

- Communication & Storytelling – Translates complex data into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.

- Proactive Problem-Solving – Anticipates product and market challenges and proposes data-backed solutions.

- Attention to Detail – Ensures accuracy and consistency across all reports and analyses.

- Adaptability & Multi-Tasking – Manages competing priorities across 8+ product lines effectively.

- Business Acumen – Understands the commercial implications of product decisions and market dynamics.

- Stakeholder Management – Builds trust and credibility with Product Line Managers and senior leadership.

Working Relationships

- Internal : Product Line Managers (LPC, Medium UPS, Energy Storage, PSD, Busway, SWGR, Microgrid, Software & Controls), Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales & Business Development, Finance, IT/ERP Teams, Plant Operations

- External : Market Research Firms, Industry Analysts, Customers (for VoC studies), Technology Partners


Position Summary

We are seeking a seasoned and analytically driven Product Manager to support the entire AC Power product portfolio. The incumbent will work as a central analytical resource, closely collaborating with Product Line Managers across Large Power Converter, Medium UPS, Energy Storage, Power Switching & Distribution, Busway, Switchgear, Microgrid, and Software & Controls product lines. This role demands a strong blend of product knowledge, data analytics, market intelligence, and cross-functional coordination to drive informed decision-making across the AC Power business.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Leads the strategic functional direction of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) modules at global scale — ensuring cross-module coherence, driving process convergence across regions, and shaping the long-term evolution of the platform. Serves as the single point of design authority for Oracle EBS functional domains, translating enterprise business strategy into a unified, scalable ERP roadmap aligned to global services operations.

Responsibilities

Strategic Governance & Platform Direction

- Governs the strategic evolution of Oracle EBS functional domains, ensuring coherence and harmonization across all global modules and business units

- Defines and drives global convergence initiatives — aligning processes, data models, and solution patterns across regions to eliminate fragmentation

- Leads the translation of business strategy into Oracle EBS functional direction, serving as the bridge between enterprise objectives and platform capabilities

- Shapes the long-term platform roadmap, anticipating business needs and positioning Oracle EBS capabilities ahead of demand

Prioritization & Demand Management

- Owns the end-to-end prioritization process for Oracle EBS capabilities, balancing global needs, functional dependencies, and long-term transformation goals

- Validates and refines business demand, ensuring correct alignment of backlog items with strategic priorities and architectural standards

- Arbitrates competing priorities across regions and business units, applying a consistent framework for investment decisions

Design Authority & Solution Oversight

- Coordinates feasibility assessments, high-level solutioning, and design authority activities across functional teams

- Validates functional solutions and configuration enhancements against platform integrity, cross-module dependencies, and scalability requirements

- Evaluates long-term implications of design choices, ensuring decisions do not create technical debt or compromise future flexibility

Roadmap Execution & Delivery Governance

- Validates cross-functional platform initiatives and Oracle EBS module enhancement roadmaps, including scope definition and delivery planning

- Tracks completion of Oracle EBS module enhancements — including configuration updates, functional changes, and release outcomes

- Ensures delivery milestones align with committed timelines and that release outcomes meet functional acceptance criteria

Qualifications

Experience

- 8-10 years of experience in Oracle EBS product ownership, functional leadership, or global process governance

- Proven track record managing Oracle EBS modules at enterprise scale, including cross-module alignment and multi-region convergence

- Demonstrated experience prioritizing complex Oracle EBS backlogs and balancing global, functional, and technical constraints

- Experience operating within matrixed, multi-stakeholder environments across geographies and business units

Education

- University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent experience; Advanced Degree may be required

Technical Skills

- Deep understanding of Oracle EBS architectures, module interactions, and integration patterns

- Ability to evaluate functional impacts, cross-module dependencies, and long-term implications of design choices

- Familiarity with Oracle EBS configuration management, release processes, and upgrade planning

- Working knowledge of data models, process harmonization frameworks, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) convergence methodologies

Services Operations

- Strong understanding of end-to-end services lifecycle processes including service contract management, field service dispatch, installed base management, depot repair, and warranty/entitlement administration

- Ability to translate services business requirements into Oracle EBS functional specifications and configuration decisions

- Familiarity with service revenue recognition models, preventive maintenance scheduling, and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance frameworks

- Understanding of field workforce management, spare parts logistics, and customer entitlement workflows within ERP environments

Communication & Influence

- Ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs to senior business stakeholders in clear, decision-ready terms

- Proven ability to build consensus across competing regional and functional priorities

- Skilled at orchestrating alignment across distributed teams without direct authority

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinking — ability to connect platform decisions to long-term business outcomes

- Decisive leadership — comfortable making high-stakes prioritization calls with incomplete information

- Systems-level perspective — sees interdependencies across modules, regions, and timelines

- Influence without authority — drives convergence and alignment across matrixed organizations

Physical & Environmental Demands

- Standard office environment; no unusual physical demands

Time Travel Required

jobs.description:
Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a  Global Product Manager  to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

The Global Product Manager – Chilled Water Systems leads the global strategy, development, and lifecycle management of the Thermal Chilled Water product portfolio. The role is responsible for driving business growth and profitability by aligning global product strategies with regional market needs, overseeing New Product Development, and optimizing the existing portfolio. Working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and commercial teams, the position ensures effective product positioning, competitive offerings, and successful go-to-market execution worldwide.

What kind of work will you be doing?

The Global Product Manager – Chilled Water Systems is responsible for the end-to-end management of the Thermal Chilled Water product portfolio, leading its strategic development, positioning, and execution on a global scale. This role plays a critical part in driving sustainable business growth by ensuring strong alignment between global strategy and regional market needs, while enabling effective execution across all phases of the product lifecycle.

Working in close collaboration with Regional Business Teams, the Global Product Manager ensures that clear, data-driven product strategies are defined and consistently deployed worldwide. This includes identifying growth opportunities, addressing market gaps, and adapting the portfolio to evolving customer requirements, regulatory environments, and technological trends.

A core responsibility of the role is the ownership of both New Product Development (NPD) and lifecycle management of the existing portfolio. This involves defining product roadmaps, building business cases, and leading cross-functional development processes to deliver competitive, high-quality solutions aligned with time-to-market, cost, and performance targets. In parallel, the role ensures continuous optimization of the current portfolio through cost reduction initiatives, feature enhancements, rationalization activities, and end-of-life strategies, with a constant focus on profitability and market relevance.

The Global Product Manager is accountable for financial performance at portfolio level, including revenue growth, margin expansion. In addition, the role defines and drives global product positioning, value proposition development, pricing frameworks, and commercial enablement. The Global Product Manager supports regional teams with tools, training, and guidance to ensure successful product launches and consistent market messaging worldwide.

Reporting to the Senior Global Product Manager, this role operates in a highly cross-functional environment, collaborating closely with Engineering, Regional Product Management, Project Management, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

- Define and execute the global product strategy aligned with business objectives and market trends

- Develop and maintain a multi-year product roadmap by segment and application

- Identify product portfolio gaps, overlaps, and rationalization opportunities

- Ensure alignment between global direction and regional requirements

New Product Development (NPD) & Innovation

- Collaborate with R&D to develop competitive and future-ready solutions

- Prioritize investments based on strategic and financial impact

Regional Alignment & Stakeholder Management

- Align global roadmap with regional needs and growth opportunities

- Act as the key interface between global and regional teams

- Support regions with product guidance and strategic direction

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

- Drive alignment across engineering, operations, and commercial teams

- Lead cross-functional initiatives in a matrix organization

- Ensure successful product industrialization and execution

This role is the region's primary interface with the Global Business Units (GBUs) responsible for global product platform development, and is accountable for converting EMEA market requirements, including the rapid scale-up of AI Factory, hyperscale and colocation infrastructure, into funded global roadmap commitments. The Sr. Director builds and leads the regional Product Line Manager team, sets the operating standards that team works to, and ensures the portfolio is positioned, priced and ready to sell ahead of customer demand.

The role carries an EMEA-wide remit across a Power product portfolio of approximately $1 billion, with a mandate to double the business within three years.

This is a strategic leadership role rather than a steady-state portfolio administration function. The Power BU is moving from a historically single-digit organic growth trajectory to a 30–40% growth mandate, driven by the pace and scale of AI Factory and hyperscale infrastructure build-out. The Sr. Director is expected to operate as a credible strategic partner to global R&D and GBU leadership, shaping how the portfolio evolves rather than simply administering what it receives and to hold product quality and lead-time competitiveness as headline measures of how well that portfolio performs in market.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Growth Mandate

- Lead the shift from a historically reactive, single-digit-growth regional operating model to a proactive model capable of supporting 30–40% portfolio growth, driven by hyperscale and AI Factory demand.

- Operate as a credible strategic partner to global R&D and GBU leadership, with the gravitas to influence platform investment decisions and to make the commercial case for regional requirements in a fast-moving, high-growth market.

- Champion a portfolio mindset across the region that treats product quality, lead time and availability as competitive differentiators, not just operational metrics — and holds the Product Line Manager team accountable accordingly.

Business Direction & Portfolio Strategy

- Define the EMEA Power product vision and multi-year portfolio strategy in partnership with the EMEA Power BU leadership team; translate it into actionable plans for each product line.

- Build and lead a team of Product Line Managers, each accountable for the regional roadmap, lifecycle and commercial performance of their assigned product line.

- Continuously map evolving requirements across hyperscale, colocation, NEO Cloud and enterprise segments, grid interconnection standards, thermal load profiles, regional compliance — into product and platform requirements.

- Translate AI-driven load volatility and evolving grid-connection requirements into BESS, UPS and power-conversion platform requirements — positioning energy storage as a grid-connection enabler, not only an optimisation layer.

- Anticipate and shape the portfolio for emerging power architectures — higher-voltage DC distribution (e.g., 800VDC), rack-level power delivery, sidecar energy storage ensuring EMEA requirements are represented in GBU platform planning early.

Global Business Unit Interface & Roadmap Influence

- Serve as the region's primary voice within global product steering forums; represent EMEA market requirements with the data and urgency needed to secure GBU prioritization and funding.

- Identify critical customer feature and capacity gaps at the earliest design stage and drive their inclusion in global R&D pipelines, ahead of the point where deployment timelines compress and changes become costly.

- Hold GBUs accountable for delivery against agreed regional commitments; escalate and help resolve roadmap conflicts where regional and global priorities diverge.

Product Lifecycle & Commercialization

- Own end-to-end product lifecycle management, phase-in through phase-out, across all eight product lines, including regional adaptations and configurations.

- Lead cross-functional product introduction programs, ensuring Technical Sales and Presales & Application Engineering teams have documentation, certifications, training and collateral ready ahead of formal product launches.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Product Strategist - Emerging Technologies is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and developing product and market strategies for next-generation technologies that will shape the future of data center infrastructure. This role serves as a key link between market intelligence, customer needs, technology innovation, product management, engineering, and business leadership. The Product Strategist assesses emerging market trends, competitive dynamics, customer requirements, and technology advancements to support Vertiv’s long-term growth strategy, product roadmap development, and investment decisions.

This position will be based onsite at our Westerville, OH location.

Responsibilities:

- Commercial Assessment: Evaluate research programs for commercial potential — assessing market demand, technical feasibility, regulatory pathway, and time-to-market.

- Customer Discovery & Competitive Analysis: Conduct customer discovery interviews, competitive landscape analysis, and market sizing to inform research priorities and investment decisions.

- Research-to-Business Alignment: Work with research teams to align research roadmaps with business strategy, product portfolio needs, and market timing.

- Go-to-Market Planning: Develop preliminary go-to-market strategies for promising research outcomes, including pricing frameworks, channel strategies, and launch sequencing.

- Proof-of-Concept Guidance: Guide proof-of-concept development to ensure experiments address business-critical questions (not just technical curiosity).

- Regulatory & IP Strategy: Identify regulatory requirements and intellectual property considerations that impact commercialization timelines and investment decisions.

- Cross-BU Collaboration: Work across business units to ensure research initiatives align with broader market needs and avoid duplication of effort.

- Financial Modeling: Build business cases and financial models to support investment decisions, including TAM/SAM analysis, ROI projections, and risk-adjusted returns.

Preferred Competencies:

- Strategic Thinking with Commercial Pragmatism

- Commercial Acumen and Business Case Development

- Customer Empathy and Voice of Customer Discovery

- Comfort with Ambiguity in Early-Stage Research

- Energy Efficiency and Sustainability Solutions

Requirements:

- 8–10 years in product strategy, product management, or business development in technology-driven organizations.

- Demonstrated success in evaluating and commercializing early-stage technology or research.

- Strong market analysis, customer discovery, and competitive intelligence skills.

- Ability to assess technical feasibility at a conceptual level (without needing to do the engineering).

- Excellent stakeholder management — ability to influence without authority across research, engineering, and commercial teams.

- Experience building business cases and financial models for technology investments.

Preferred:

- Background in engineering, science, or technical field (degree or equivalent experience).

- Industry experience in data center infrastructure, thermal management, power systems, or energy efficiency.

- Understanding of regulatory environments relevant to infrastructure technology.

- Experience working with or within R&D organizations.
